2607.15146.title: Grokipedia vs Wikipedia: An LLM-Based Audit of Political Neutrality along Ideologies
2607.15146.paper_summary: Online encyclopedias shape political opinion and, through it, democratic discourse. In late 2025, Grokipedia was released, an encyclopedia written entirely by the LLM Grok. One motivation behind the project was to provide an unbiased alternative to Wikipedia, which has faced accusations of "left-wing" and "liberal" bias. But does an encyclopedia written by an LLM deliver greater neutrality, or does it simply embed a different ideology? We conduct a large-scale political bias study on Grokipedia and Wikipedia, analysing 1,394 article pairs describing members of government for neutrality along nine expert-coded ideology dimensions employing four LLM judges, Grok, Claude, Mistral, and DeepSeek. As the LLMs could themselves be biased, we also investigate patterns in their judgments. We find all LLM-judges, including Grok, to rate Grokipedia less neutral than Wikipedia. Both encyclopedias are rated as portraying politicians favourably overall, but towards different ideological groups. Grokipedia particularly favours economically right-wing politicians and penalises socially liberal ones, while Wikipedia is rated as favourably biased towards the latter.
2607.15146.paper_summary_zh: 在線百科全書塑造政治觀點，並通過這一點影響民主話語。2025年底，Grokipedia發布，這是一部完全由LLM Grok編寫的百科全書。這個項目背後的一個動機是提供一個無偏見的替代品，以對抗面臨「左翼」和「自由」偏見指控的維基百科。但由LLM編寫的百科全書是否提供了更大的中立性，還是僅僅嵌入了不同的意識形態？我們對Grokipedia和維基百科進行了一項大規模的政治偏見研究，分析了1,394對描述政府成員的文章對，在九個專家編碼的意識形態維度上評估中立性，並使用四位LLM評審，分別是Grok、Claude、Mistral和DeepSeek。由於LLM本身可能存在偏見，我們還調查了它們判斷中的模式。我們發現所有LLM評審，包括Grok，都評價Grokipedia的中立性低於維基百科。兩部百科全書都被評價為整體上有利於政治家，但偏向不同的意識形態群體。Grokipedia特別偏向經濟右派政治家，並懲罰社會自由派政治家，而維基百科則被評價為對後者有利的偏見。
